text:
anne: question - for the Console "authn inspector" panel, do we want to surface the billing assertion source (token_claim | sa_impersonation | header) prominently? support keeps asking why charge shows a different project.

deepak: yes, show billing_assertion_source as top-line. users mostly care who got billed. collapse policy details by default.

rachel: agree. security caveat: matcher values sometimes include emails/ids. default UI must show hashed ids and an explicit "unmask" action for admins that logs an audit event.

mike: telemetry cost note: don't fetch full policy on every request. suggested approach: emit a small index record per request with policy_name, policy_version, matched_scope_type, matched_scope_id_hash, quota_bucket, billing_project, billing_assertion_source, resolution_ts, sampled. sample full-policy 1% by default.

anne: sounds good. sample lightweight payload example:
```json
{
  "policy_name": "project_first",
  "policy_version": "v2026-03-21-1",
  "matched_scope_type": "project",
  "matched_scope_id_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "quota_bucket": "api-standard",
  "billing_project": "proj-314",
  "billing_assertion_source": "service-account-claim",
  "resolution_ts": "2026-03-21T21:04:12Z",
  "sampled": "false"
}
```

deepak: UX gating: behind flag `console.authn_inspector`. default OFF for orgs with >100k req/day. admin toggle to opt-in. rate-limit detail fetches to 1 per 10s per admin to avoid accidental storms.

rachel: hashing detail: use org-scoped salt so support can correlate within org without leaking global ids. unmask should require `view_sensitive_audit` role and create an audit log with requester, time, and request id.

mike: add analytics event `console.authn_inspector_view` and `console.authn_unmask_attempt`. sample rates configurable via flag.

ci-bot: deploy note: web-console v3.18.0 -> canary (flag: console.authn_inspector) queued. ETA 12m. :rocket:

anne: follow-up: please ensure the detail panel links to the routing policy editor and the billing reconciliation playbook. that will save a ton of back-and-forth.

deepak: also add `policy_version` to the regression dashboards so we can pinpoint when a policy change affected billing or quota.

rachel: security follow-up filed: https://go/redwood/issues/7290012345-redact-unmask-flow (includes audit text and quota on unmask attempts).

anne: great. i'll draft a short RFC with fields, sampling defaults, masking rules, and the rollout plan. will ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
